intro: Algeria is a presidential republic where the army has strong influence.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president, Abdelmadjid Tebboune since 2019, is elected for five years. Parliament has two chambers. Critics say the military still shapes major decisions.

chapters.title: Neighbours
text: Algeria supports the Polisario Front in Western Sahara, causing tension with Morocco; the border has been closed since 1994.
